adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.createEvent the target calendar is now chosen via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId;` and falls back to `"primary"` when not found. If a legacy destinationCalendar entry has `credentialId` null/undefined but still has a user-selected `externalId`, it will never match the lookup, so `selectedCalendar` becomes undefined and the insert uses `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`, creating the event in the credential's primary calendar instead of the selected externalId. The diff also shows legacy handling paths (e.g., EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents branch where `destination.credentialId` is falsy) that still call createEvent without providing an externalId override, making this fallback behavior reachable.
